newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end down, but off early lows.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end down, but off early lows.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended down on Thursday amid concerns about the outcome of Pakistan-IMF talks, but the index recovered slightly towards the close on short-covering in select blue chips, dealers said.

The Karachi 100-share index fell 3.58 points, or 0.26 percent, to end at 1,357.92 from 1.355.08 at noon. Losers led gainers 129 to 67. PTCL fell 0.10 rupees to 31.15. Dewan Salman Fibre rose 0.20 to 25.40. "Short-covering helped the index to recover, but there was little genuine activity. All eyes are set on the final outcome of Pakistan-IMF talks," one dealer said.
